description: Resolves what a config/env variable actually evaluates to across dotenv, docker-compose, and Kubernetes sources, and which source wins.

container.description: Kubernetes container name within the workload

environment.description: Target NODE_ENV-style value for dotenv resolution, e.g. "production"

files.description: Paths (relative to projectRoot) to .env*, compose, and k8s manifest files to consider

projectRoot.description: Directory the file paths are relative to

service.description: docker-compose service name to resolve for

workload.description: Kubernetes workload (Deployment/Pod/etc.) name to resolve for

name: resolve_variable
